text: That is a significant finding; however, given your 25-year smoking history and daily exposure to dust and fumes as a mechanic, we must also rule out chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and lung cancer. text: RESULTS: Hyperinflated lungs with increased anterior-posterior diameter, no evidence of infiltrates or masses.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with confirmed Cushing's syndrome. The chest X-ray findings of hyperinflated lungs and increased AP diameter, combined with your 25-year smoking history and occupational exposure, are classic for COPD. The elevated urinary cortisol confirms a concurrent diagnosis of Cushing's syndrome, which may be contributing to your respiratory symptoms.
